name: React, Three.js, ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL
description: RIGG is a full-stack SaaS platform for browser-based 3D pose editing. Built with React and Three.js on the frontend and ASP.NET Core with PostgreSQL on the backend, it features real-time collaboration via SignalR, Stripe subscriptions, and cloud file storage on Cloudflare R2.

name: React, ONNX Runtime Web, Web Workers
description: AutoColouringPage runs a neural network entirely in the browser to convert photos into printable colouring page line art. Built with React and ONNX Runtime Web, it uses Web Workers and tile-based inference so heavy ML processing never blocks the UI.

name: React, JavaScript, CSS
description: This portfolio site is built using React, JavaScript, and CSS, showcasing my skills in modern front-end development, interactive components, and responsive design. It features p5.js for animations and smooth navigation.

name: Node.js, SQL, Flask, AI
description: The Lyrical Project backend uses Node.js, SQL, Flask, and locally hosted AI to handle API requests, manage databases, generate music sequences, and apply machine learning for unique piano roll compositions.

name: C#, Unity, 2D Game Development
description: Below the Couches was developed using C#, Unity, and 2D game development principles, handling game logic, physics, and level design for an engaging puzzle experience.
